scripts.import-content: PYTHONPATH=services/api uv run --project services/api python -m app.cli import-content
scripts.make-placeholders: PYTHONPATH=services/api uv run --project services/api python -m app.cli make-placeholders
scripts.jobs:submit-mocks: PYTHONPATH=services/api uv run --project services/api python -m app.cli submit-expired-mocks
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @kursu/app lint && prettier --check apps/app packages/api-client package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml docker-compose.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml && uv run --directory services/api ruff check . && uv run --directory services/api ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && uv run --directory services/api mypy
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @kursu/app test && uv run --directory services/api pytest
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
